# 1. What this document does

**Task T29 (F1.2):** day-ahead (24 h) forecasts of `energy_wh_model` for HVAC, Lighting and Plugs & Sockets in every zone where the load exists, using the model-ready dataset v0.4.

| Item | Decision |
|---|---|
| Input | `cedint_f1_model_ready.csv` only (no internet, no extra files) |
| Series | zone × load type for HVAC, Lighting, Plugs & Sockets (10 series) |
| Models | Seasonal naive (same hour last week) and LightGBM |
| Split | The `split` column of the file (train 2020-06 → 2022-06, validation 2022-H2, test 2023, test 2025). Rows are used only if `include_train = 1` (training) or `include_eval = 1` (evaluation). |
| Day-ahead rule | Every feature derived from the target is lagged by **24 h or more**, so the forecast for hour *t* only uses data up to *t − 24 h*. |
| Tuning | 6 LightGBM configurations. Each one is trained on the training rows and stopped early on the validation rows. The best on validation is kept. No cross-validation loop. |
| Outputs | Predictions, ASHRAE 14 metrics, best parameters, feature importance, experiment-log rows and a forecast file for T30. |

# 2. Packages and configuration

```{r packages}
pkgs <- c("data.table", "lightgbm", "ggplot2", "knitr")
miss <- setdiff(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(miss)) stop("Install first: install.packages(c(", paste0("'", miss, "'", collapse = ", "), "))")
invisible(lapply(pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE))
```

```{r config}
CFG <- list(
  data_file = "cedint_f1_model_ready.csv",   
  out_dir   = "outputs_T29",
  author    = "María Herraiz",
  loads     = c("HVAC", "Lighting", "Plugs & Sockets"),
  eval_splits = c("validation", "test_2023", "test_2025"),
  max_rounds  = 500,      # maximum LightGBM trees (early stopping usually stops earlier)
  early_stop  = 30,
  threads     = 4,
  seed        = 42
)
dir.create(CFG$out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
set.seed(CFG$seed)
```

# 3. Helpers

```{r helpers}
# ASHRAE Guideline 14 (hourly): CV(RMSE) <= 30 %, |NMBE| <= 10 %.
# NMBE > 0 means over-forecast (same convention as T30).
metrics <- function(a, p) {
  ok <- is.finite(a) & is.finite(p); a <- a[ok]; p <- p[ok]; n <- length(a)
  if (n < 24) return(data.table(n = n, MAE = NA_real_, RMSE = NA_real_,
                                CV_RMSE = NA_real_, NMBE = NA_real_, ASHRAE_pass = NA))
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((a - p)^2)); cv <- 100 * rmse / mean(a); nmbe <- 100 * sum(p - a) / (n * mean(a))
  data.table(n = n, MAE = mean(abs(a - p)), RMSE = rmse, CV_RMSE = cv, NMBE = nmbe,
             ASHRAE_pass = (cv <= 30) & (abs(nmbe) <= 10))
}

# Value of y exactly k hours earlier. Matching on the timestamp (not on the row position)
# keeps the lags correct across the 902-day gap: there the lag is NA.
lagk <- function(y, tn, k) y[match(tn - k * 3600, tn)]
```

# 4. Data

```{r data}
if (!file.exists(CFG$data_file)) stop("Cannot find ", CFG$data_file, " in ", getwd())

keep <- c("timestamp_utc", "zone", "load_type", "split", "include_train", "include_eval",
          "energy_wh_model", "hour_local", "dayofweek_local", "month_local", "is_weekend",
          "is_holiday", "is_august_low_use", "flag_covid_2020",
          "temp_c", "hum_pct", "lum_lux", "occupancy")
dt <- fread(CFG$data_file, select = keep, colClasses = list(character = "timestamp_utc"))
dt <- dt[load_type %in% CFG$loads]
dt[, ts := as.POSIXct(timestamp_utc, tz = "UTC", format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")]
stopifnot(!anyNA(dt$ts), !anyDuplicated(dt, by = c("ts", "zone", "load_type")))
setnames(dt, "energy_wh_model", "y")
setorder(dt, zone, load_type, ts)

series <- unique(dt[, .(zone, load_type)])
kable(dt[, .(hours_with_target = sum(!is.na(y)),
             train = sum(include_train == 1 & !is.na(y)),
             validation = sum(include_eval == 1 & split == "validation" & !is.na(y)),
             test_2023 = sum(include_eval == 1 & split == "test_2023" & !is.na(y)),
             test_2025 = sum(include_eval == 1 & split == "test_2025" & !is.na(y))),
         by = .(zone, load_type)],
      caption = "Usable hours per series (SW has no 2025 data; NE has no Lighting; SW has no HVAC)")
```

# 5. Features (day-ahead safe)

```{r features}
make_features <- function(s) {
  tn <- as.numeric(s$ts); y <- s$y
  for (k in c(24, 48, 72, 168, 336)) set(s, j = paste0("lag_", k), value = lagk(y, tn, k))
  r24 <- rowMeans(sapply(24:47, function(k) lagk(y, tn, k)), na.rm = TRUE)       # mean of the previous day
  r7d <- rowMeans(sapply(1:7, function(d) lagk(y, tn, 24 * d)), na.rm = TRUE)    # same hour, last 7 days
  set(s, j = "mean_prev_day",     value = ifelse(is.nan(r24), NA_real_, r24))
  set(s, j = "same_hour_mean_7d", value = ifelse(is.nan(r7d), NA_real_, r7d))
  for (v in c("temp_c", "hum_pct", "lum_lux", "occupancy"))   # indoor drivers, lagged 24 h only
    set(s, j = paste0(v, "_l24"), value = lagk(s[[v]], tn, 24))
  s
}

base_feats <- c("hour_local", "dayofweek_local", "month_local", "is_weekend", "is_holiday",
                "is_august_low_use", "flag_covid_2020",
                paste0("lag_", c(24, 48, 72, 168, 336)), "mean_prev_day", "same_hour_mean_7d",
                paste0(c("temp_c", "hum_pct", "lum_lux", "occupancy"), "_l24"))
```

# 6. Train and evaluate one series

```{r model}
GRID <- data.table(expand.grid(num_leaves = c(15, 31, 63), min_data_in_leaf = c(20, 100)))

run_series <- function(s) {
  s <- make_features(copy(s))
  tr <- s[include_train == 1 & !is.na(y)]
  va <- s[include_eval == 1 & split == "validation" & !is.na(y)]
  if (nrow(tr) < 24 * 100 || nrow(va) < 24) stop("too little training/validation data")

  # drop features that are empty in training (e.g. NE has no indoor sensors)
  feats <- base_feats[vapply(base_feats, function(f) any(!is.na(tr[[f]])), logical(1))]
  Xtr <- as.matrix(tr[, ..feats]); Xva <- as.matrix(va[, ..feats])

  best <- NULL
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(GRID))) {
    prm <- list(objective = "regression", metric = "rmse", learning_rate = 0.05,
                num_leaves = GRID$num_leaves[i], min_data_in_leaf = GRID$min_data_in_leaf[i],
                feature_fraction = 0.8, bagging_fraction = 0.8, bagging_freq = 1, lambda_l2 = 1,
                early_stopping_round = CFG$early_stop, seed = CFG$seed,
                num_threads = CFG$threads, verbosity = -1)
    dtr <- lgb.Dataset(Xtr, label = tr$y)
    dva <- lgb.Dataset.create.valid(dtr, Xva, label = va$y)
    m <- lgb.train(params = prm, data = dtr, nrounds = CFG$max_rounds,
                   valids = list(valid = dva), verbose = -1)
    sc <- m$best_score
    if (is.null(best) || sc < best$score) best <- list(model = m, score = sc, prm = prm, iter = m$best_iter)
  }

  # predictions for all evaluation rows
  ev <- s[include_eval == 1 & split %in% CFG$eval_splits & !is.na(y)]
  ev[, lgb := pmax(predict(best$model, as.matrix(ev[, ..feats]), num_iteration = best$iter), 0)]
  ev[, naive := lag_168]

  # fair comparison: same hours for both models (hours where lag_168 exists)
  common <- ev[!is.na(naive)]
  met <- rbindlist(list(
    common[, c(list(model = "SeasonalNaive"), metrics(y, naive)), by = split],
    common[, c(list(model = "LightGBM"),      metrics(y, lgb)),   by = split]))

  imp <- lgb.importance(best$model, percentage = TRUE)[order(-Gain)][1:min(10, .N), .(Feature, Gain)]
  list(met = met, ev = ev, imp = imp, n_feats = length(feats),
       par = best$prm[c("num_leaves", "min_data_in_leaf", "learning_rate", "feature_fraction",
                        "bagging_fraction", "lambda_l2")],
       iter = best$iter, valid_rmse = best$score)
}
```

# 7. Run all series

Each series takes seconds. The message shows progress and the time used.

```{r run}
results <- list(); timing <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(series))) {
  z <- series$zone[i]; l <- series$load_type[i]; key <- paste(z, l)
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  results[[key]] <- tryCatch(run_series(dt[zone == z & load_type == l]),
                             error = function(e) { message("FAILED ", key, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  secs <- round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")), 1)
  timing[[key]] <- data.table(series = key, seconds = secs, ok = !is.null(results[[key]]))
  message(sprintf("[%d/%d] %s  %.1f s", i, nrow(series), key, secs))
}
failed <- names(results)[vapply(results, is.null, logical(1))]
results <- Filter(Negate(is.null), results)
if (!length(results)) stop("All series failed: read the FAILED messages above")
kable(rbindlist(timing), caption = "Run time per series")
```

# 8. Results

```{r metrics}
met_all <- rbindlist(lapply(names(results), function(k) {
  m <- copy(results[[k]]$met); m[, `:=`(zone = sub(" .*", "", k), load_type = sub("^[^ ]+ ", "", k))]; m
}))
setcolorder(met_all, c("zone", "load_type", "model", "split"))
kable(met_all[order(load_type, zone, split, model)][, lapply(.SD, function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) round(x, 2) else x)],
      caption = "ASHRAE 14 metrics per series, model and period (same hours for both models)")
```

```{r best}
b <- dcast(met_all, zone + load_type + split ~ model, value.var = "CV_RMSE")
kable(b[, .(zone, load_type, split, naive_CV = round(SeasonalNaive, 1), lgb_CV = round(LightGBM, 1),
            LightGBM_beats_naive = LightGBM < SeasonalNaive)][order(split, load_type, zone)],
      caption = "CV(RMSE) %: LightGBM against the baseline")
cat("Series passing ASHRAE 14 (LightGBM):\n")
print(met_all[model == "LightGBM", .(passing = sum(ASHRAE_pass, na.rm = TRUE), total = .N), by = split])
```

```{r plot_cv}
ggplot(met_all[!is.na(CV_RMSE)], aes(paste(zone, load_type), CV_RMSE, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + facet_wrap(~split) + coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, linetype = 2) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "CV(RMSE) %", title = "Day-ahead CV(RMSE) by series (dashed line = ASHRAE 14 limit, 30 %)")
```

```{r importance}
imp_all <- rbindlist(lapply(names(results), function(k) cbind(series = k, results[[k]]$imp)))
kable(imp_all[, .SD[1:5], by = series][, .(series, Feature, Gain_pct = round(100 * Gain, 1))],
      caption = "Top-5 LightGBM features by gain (input for T33 / SHAP)")
```

# 9. Save outputs

```{r save}
# (a) predictions in the team format: timestamp_utc, zone, load_type, model, split, y_true, y_pred
pred_all <- rbindlist(lapply(names(results), function(k) {
  e <- results[[k]]$ev; z <- sub(" .*", "", k); l <- sub("^[^ ]+ ", "", k)
  rbind(e[!is.na(naive), .(timestamp_utc = format(ts, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), zone = z, load_type = l,
                           model = "SeasonalNaive", split, y_true = y, y_pred = naive)],
        e[, .(timestamp_utc = format(ts, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), zone = z, load_type = l,
              model = "LightGBM", split, y_true = y, y_pred = lgb)])
}))
fwrite(pred_all, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "T29_dayahead_predictions.csv"))

# (b) file read by the T30 script (zone_load_forecasts_T29.csv): LightGBM forecasts only
fwrite(pred_all[model == "LightGBM", .(timestamp = timestamp_utc, zone, load_type, forecast_wh = y_pred)],
       file.path(CFG$out_dir, "zone_load_forecasts_T29.csv"))

# (c) metrics, importance and best parameters
fwrite(met_all, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "T29_metrics_ashrae.csv"))
fwrite(imp_all, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "T29_lgb_importance.csv"))
par_tab <- rbindlist(lapply(names(results), function(k) {
  r <- results[[k]]
  data.table(series = k, as.data.table(r$par), best_iteration = r$iter,
             n_features = r$n_feats, valid_rmse = round(r$valid_rmse, 2))
}))
fwrite(par_tab, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "T29_best_params.csv"))
kable(par_tab, caption = "Best LightGBM configuration per series")

# (d) rows for experiment_log.xlsx (columns agreed in T20): paste them into the log
rng <- function(sp) {
  d <- pred_all[split == sp, as.Date(timestamp_utc)]
  if (!length(d)) NA_character_ else paste(format(min(d)), "to", format(max(d)))
}
test_period <- vapply(CFG$eval_splits, rng, character(1))
log_rows <- met_all[order(zone, load_type, match(split, CFG$eval_splits), model), .(
  ID = sprintf("T29-%03d", .I), date = format(Sys.Date()), author = CFG$author,
  series = paste(zone, load_type),
  features = ifelse(model == "SeasonalNaive", "lag_168",
                    "calendar, target lags >= 24 h, mean previous day, same-hour mean 7 d, indoor lag 24 h"),
  model = ifelse(model == "SeasonalNaive", "Seasonal naive (same hour last week)", "LightGBM (tuned, 6 configs)"),
  `train period` = "2020-06-01 to 2022-06-30",
  `test period` = paste0(split, ": ", test_period[split]),
  MAE = round(MAE, 1), RMSE = round(RMSE, 1), `CV(RMSE)` = round(CV_RMSE, 2), NMBE = round(NMBE, 2),
  notes = sprintf("T29 day-ahead; n=%d h; ASHRAE14 %s; NMBE>0 = over-forecast", n, ifelse(ASHRAE_pass, "PASS", "FAIL")))]
fwrite(log_rows, file.path(CFG$out_dir, "T29_experiment_log_rows.csv"))
if (length(failed)) cat("Series that failed:", paste(failed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Files written to", normalizePath(CFG$out_dir), ":\n"); print(list.files(CFG$out_dir))
```
